channel.title: Use Of Another Author's/Existing Characters
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Use Of Another Author's/Existing Characters" - Is it okay to feature or reference an existing doctor or character that was not written by me in my SCP article?

item.title: Re: Use Of Another Author's/Existing Characters
item.content:encoded: It should totally be fine as long as you don’t plagiarize anything.

item.title: Use Of Another Author's/Existing Characters
item.content:encoded: Hello, I'm pretty new here and in the process of writing my first SCP article. I'm wanting to feature a few psychological evaluation interviews conducted on a doctor in my article, and was wondering if it is okay to use have an existing character that wasn't written by me conducting the interview, such as Dr. Glass. I'm not sure what the policy is regarding using existing foundation characters written by other authors in your work. I know it's fine in tales, but if someone could just clear things up for me that would be great.
